name: RC-B10-0121/2026 – § 5 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text: 5. Notes that during the period 2021-2024, the EU supported Uganda with EUR 94 million to improve governance and social inclusion; calls for the EU and encourages its Member States to review cooperation with and assistance for Uganda in the field of democracy and governance, in order to prevent any further waste of taxpayers’ money;
